import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
customer_segments = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Convert 'Dt_Customer' to datetime type
customer_segments['Dt_Customer'] = pd.to_datetime(customer_segments['Dt_Customer'])

# Create a correlation heatmap
corr_matrix = customer_segments[['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds', 'NumDealsPurchases', 'NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases', 'NumWebVisitsMonth']].corr()
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, cmap='coolwarm', square=True)
plt.title('Correlation Heatmap of Spending Behavior')
plt.xlabel('Variables')
plt.ylabel('Variables')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
